# dna domain

Search, register, renew, transfer and manage domains.

## dna domain bulk-search

```
dna domain bulk-search <domains>... [flags]
```

Check availability and prices of several domains at once.

- **Safety:** read-only (no side effects)
- **API:** `POST /api/v1/domains/bulk-search`
- **Body:** `DomainSearchInput[]`
- **Returns:** `BulkDomainSearchResultDto`
- **Schema:** `dna schema domain.bulk-search` (MCP tool: `domain_bulk_search`)

Every input can also be given as JSON with --body (inline, @file or - for stdin); flags override it.

| flag | type | description |
|---|---|---|
| `--domains` | strings | Domain names to check (repeatable) (required; or argument 1 &lt;domains&gt;) |
| `--currency` | string | Price currency, e.g. USD or TRY. The API may answer in the TLD's own currency instead (check currency in the result) |
| `-d`, `--body` | string | Full input as JSON: inline, @file, or - to read stdin |

**Examples**

```bash
dna domain bulk-search example.com example.net example.org
```

## dna domain contacts set-handles

```

```

Point a domain's contact roles at existing contact handles.

Every input can also be given as JSON with --body (inline, @file or - for stdin); flags override it.

|---|---|---|

| `--handle-items` | string | Handles as JSON: [{"contactType":"Admin","handle":"DNA-2"}] (JSON, @file or -) (required; or --handle) |

## dna domain contacts update

```
dna domain contacts update <domain> [flags]
```

Replace a domain's contacts with inline contact details.

Each contact needs contactType (Registrant, Admin, Tech, Billing). Registrant changes may trigger an
owner change process and documents on some TLDs.

- **Safety:** changes data (free)
- **API:** `PUT /api/v1/domains/contacts/update`
- **Body:** `DomainContactUpdateInput`
- **Returns:** nothing (prints {"success":true})
- **Schema:** `dna schema domain.contacts.update` (MCP tool: `domain_contacts_update`)

Every input can also be given as JSON with --body (inline, @file or - for stdin); flags override it.

| flag | type | description |
|---|---|---|
| `--domain-name` | string | Domain name (required; or argument 1 &lt;domain&gt;) |
| `--contacts` | string | Contacts as a JSON array (or @file); each needs contactType (JSON, @file or -) (required; or --contact) |
| `--contact` | strings | One contact as JSON or @file, used for all four roles (Registrant, Admin, Tech, Billing) |
| `-d`, `--body` | string | Full input as JSON: inline, @file, or - to read stdin |

## dna domain documents upload

```
dna domain documents upload <domain> [flags]
```

Upload registry documents for a domain.

Upload the documents a registry asked for (domain status WaitingForDocument). Use --document
TYPE=PATH; the file is base64-encoded for you. Accepted files: PDF, JPG/JPEG, PNG, DOC, DOCX, ODT;
at most 10 MB per file and 50 MB per request.

- **Safety:** changes data (free)
- **API:** `POST /api/v1/domains/documents`
- **Body:** `DomainDocumentUploadInput`
- **Returns:** `DomainDocumentUploadResultDto`
- **Schema:** `dna schema domain.documents.upload` (MCP tool: `domain_documents_upload`)

Every input can also be given as JSON with --body (inline, @file or - for stdin); flags override it.

| flag | type | description |
|---|---|---|
| `--domain-name` | string | Domain name (required; or argument 1 &lt;domain&gt;) |
| `--documents` | string | Documents as JSON: [{documentType, fileName, fileContent(base64)}] (JSON, @file or -) (or --document) |
| `--document` | strings | Document to upload as TYPE=PATH, e.g. IdentityCard=./id.pdf (see `dna enums DocumentType`); repeatable |
| `-d`, `--body` | string | Full input as JSON: inline, @file, or - to read stdin |

**Examples**

```bash
dna domain documents upload example.com.tr --document IdentityCard=./id.pdf
```

## dna domain host add

```
dna domain host add <domain> <host> [flags]
```

Create a child nameserver (glue record) such as ns1.example.com.

Registers a host object under the domain with one or more IP addresses. The IP version is detected
for you when you use --ip.

- **Safety:** changes data (free)
- **API:** `POST /api/v1/domains/dns/host`
- **Body:** `HostAddInput`
- **Returns:** nothing (prints {"success":true})
- **Schema:** `dna schema domain.host.add` (MCP tool: `domain_host_add`)

Every input can also be given as JSON with --body (inline, @file or - for stdin); flags override it.

| flag | type | description |
|---|---|---|
| `--domain-name` | string | Domain name (max 63 chars) (required; or argument 1 &lt;domain&gt;) |
| `--host-name` | string | Host name (max 100 chars) (required; or argument 2 &lt;host&gt;) |
| `--ip-addresses` | string | IPs as JSON: [{"ipAddress":"192.0.2.1","ipVersion":"v4"}] (JSON, @file or -) (required; or --ip) |
| `--ip` | strings | IP address of the host, IPv4 or IPv6 (version detected); repeatable |
| `-d`, `--body` | string | Full input as JSON: inline, @file, or - to read stdin |

**Examples**

```bash
dna domain host add example.com ns1.example.com --ip 192.0.2.10 --ip 2001:db8::10
```

## dna domain list

```
dna domain list [flags]
```

List your domains.

Pages through the reseller's domains. Use --all to fetch every page.

| `--status-ids` | string | Filter by status, comma separated names or numbers (e.g. Active,PendingDelete) [0=Active, 1=WaitingForRegistration, 2=WaitingForDocument, 3=WaitingForIncomingTransfer, 4=TransferredOut, 5=TransferRejected, 7=PendingDelete, 8=Deleted, 9=ConfirmationEmailSend, 11=WaitingForOutgoingTransfer, 12=PendingHold, 15=ModificationPending, 18=InCase, 19=PendingRestore] |
| `--sorting` | string | Sorting |
| `--skip-count` | int | Skip count |
| `--max-result-count` | int | Max result count |
| `-d`, `--body` | string | Full input as JSON: inline, @file, or - to read stdin |
| `--all` |  | Fetch every page and return all items |

**Examples**

```bash
# Every domain as JSON

```

## dna domain nameservers set

```
dna domain nameservers set <domain> <nameserver>... [flags]
```

Replace the nameservers of a domain.

Sets the complete nameserver list. On a DNSSEC-signed domain the change is blocked unless
--dnssec-mode is KeepDnssec (new provider serves a matching DNSKEY) or DisableDnssec (remove DS
records first).

- **Safety:** changes data (free)
- **API:** `PUT /api/v1/domains/dns/name-server`
- **Body:** `DnsEditNameServerInput`
- **Returns:** nothing (prints {"success":true})
- **Schema:** `dna schema domain.nameservers.set` (MCP tool: `domain_nameservers_set`)

Every input can also be given as JSON with --body (inline, @file or - for stdin); flags override it.

| flag | type | description |
|---|---|---|
| `--domain-name` | string | Domain name (required; or argument 1 &lt;domain&gt;) |
| `--ns` | strings | Nameserver host names (repeat or comma separate) (required; or argument 2 &lt;nameserver&gt;) |
| `--dnssec-mode` | string | Block (default), KeepDnssec or DisableDnssec [0=Block, 1=KeepDnssec, 2=DisableDnssec] |
| `-d`, `--body` | string | Full input as JSON: inline, @file, or - to read stdin |

**Examples**

```bash
dna domain nameservers set example.com ns1.example.net ns2.example.net
```

## dna domain register

```
dna domain register <domain> [flags]
```

Register a domain using existing contact handles (charges balance).

Registers the domain for --period years with the given nameservers and contact handles. Check
availability and price first with `dna domain search`. Some TLDs need --tld-attributes (see `dna
product tlds --filter-text <tld>`).

- **Safety:** BILLABLE - charges your balance; asks for confirmation (--yes to skip)
- **API:** `POST /api/v1/domains/register`
- **Body:** `DomainCreateWithHandleInput`
- **Returns:** `DomainOperationResponse`
- **Schema:** `dna schema domain.register` (MCP tool: `domain_register`)

Every input can also be given as JSON with --body (inline, @file or - for stdin); flags override it.

| flag | type | description |
|---|---|---|
| `--domain-name` | string | Domain name (required; or argument 1 &lt;domain&gt;) |
| `--ns` | strings | Nameserver host names (repeat or comma separate; at least 2 usually required) (required) |
| `--handles` | string | Contact handles as JSON: [{"contactType":"Registrant","handle":"DNA-1"},...] (JSON, @file or -) (required; or --handle) |
| `--period` | int | Registration period in years (1-10) |
| `--tld-attribute` | strings | Registry-specific attribute (KEY=VALUE, repeatable) |
| `--handle` | strings | Contact handle per role as ROLE=HANDLE (Registrant, Admin, Tech, Billing), or a bare HANDLE for all four roles; repeatable |
| `-d`, `--body` | string | Full input as JSON: inline, @file, or - to read stdin |

**Examples**

```bash
# Same handle for all four roles
dna domain register example.com --period 1 --ns ns1.example.net --ns ns2.example.net --handle DNA-12345 --yes
# Preview the request
dna domain register example.com --ns ns1.example.net,ns2.example.net --handle Registrant=DNA-1 --handle Admin=DNA-2 --handle Tech=DNA-2 --handle Billing=DNA-2 --dry-run
```

## dna domain register-with-contacts

```
dna domain register-with-contacts <domain> [flags]
```

Register a domain with inline contact details (charges balance).

Like `domain register`, but contacts are given inline. All four roles (Registrant, Admin, Tech,
Billing) are required unless --use-trustee-contact is set. Pass them with --contacts @contacts.json,
or one contact for every role with --contact @contact.json.

- **Safety:** BILLABLE - charges your balance; asks for confirmation (--yes to skip)
- **API:** `POST /api/v1/domains/register-with-contacts`
- **Body:** `DomainCreateWithContactInput`
- **Returns:** `DomainOperationResponse`
- **Schema:** `dna schema domain.register-with-contacts` (MCP tool: `domain_register_with_contacts`)

Every input can also be given as JSON with --body (inline, @file or - for stdin); flags override it.

| flag | type | description |
|---|---|---|
| `--domain-name` | string | Domain name (required; or argument 1 &lt;domain&gt;) |
| `--ns` | strings | Nameserver host names (repeat or comma separate) (required) |
| `--contacts` | string | Contacts as a JSON array (or @file); each needs contactType (JSON, @file or -) (required; or --contact) |
| `--period` | int | Registration period in years (1-10) |
| `--tld-attribute` | strings | Registry-specific attribute (KEY=VALUE, repeatable) |
| `--use-trustee-contact` |  | Use the registrar's trustee contact (TLDs with isSupportTrustee) |
| `--contact` | strings | One contact as JSON or @file, used for all four roles (Registrant, Admin, Tech, Billing) |
| `-d`, `--body` | string | Full input as JSON: inline, @file, or - to read stdin |

**Examples**

```bash
dna domain register-with-contacts example.com --ns ns1.example.net,ns2.example.net --contact @contact.json --dry-run
```

## dna domain transfer

```
dna domain transfer <domain> [flags]
```

Transfer a domain in from another registrar (charges balance).

Starts an incoming transfer with the auth (EPP) code. Validate first with `dna domain
transfer-check`; follow progress with `dna domain transfer-status`.

## dna domain transfer-check

```
dna domain transfer-check <domain> <auth-code> [flags]
```

Check whether a domain can be transferred in with an auth code.

Reports transfer availability, lock state, whether the auth code is valid or required, registry
statuses and premium price. Run before `domain transfer`.

- **Safety:** read-only (no side effects)
- **API:** `POST /api/v1/domains/transfers/check`
- **Body:** `DomainTransferCheckInput`
- **Returns:** `DomainTransferCheckDto`
- **Schema:** `dna schema domain.transfer-check` (MCP tool: `domain_transfer_check`)

Every input can also be given as JSON with --body (inline, @file or - for stdin); flags override it.

| flag | type | description |
|---|---|---|
| `--domain-name` | string | Domain name (required; or argument 1 &lt;domain&gt;) |
| `--auth-code` | string | Auth code (required; or argument 2 &lt;auth-code&gt;) |
| `-d`, `--body` | string | Full input as JSON: inline, @file, or - to read stdin |

**Examples**

```bash
dna domain transfer-check example.com 'Xy7!kP2q'
```

## dna domain transfer-status

```
dna domain transfer-status <domain> [flags]
```

## dna domain unlock

```
dna domain unlock <domain> [flags]
```

Disable the transfer lock (needed before transferring out).

- **Safety:** changes data (free)
- **API:** `POST /api/v1/domains/unlock`
- **Body:** `DomainLockInput`
- **Returns:** nothing (prints {"success":true})
- **Schema:** `dna schema domain.unlock` (MCP tool: `domain_unlock`)

Every input can also be given as JSON with --body (inline, @file or - for stdin); flags override it.

| flag | type | description |
|---|---|---|
| `--domain-name` | string | Domain name (required; or argument 1 &lt;domain&gt;) |
| `-d`, `--body` | string | Full input as JSON: inline, @file, or - to read stdin |

## dna domain update-auth-code

```
dna domain update-auth-code <domain> [flags]
```

Update the transfer auth (EPP) code and return it.

Asks the registry to update the domain's transfer authorization code and returns the resulting code.
To only read the current code use `dna domain info --jq .authCode`.

- **Safety:** changes data (free)
- **API:** `PUT /api/v1/domains/auth`
- **Body:** `DomainAuthCodeUpdateInput`
- **Returns:** `DomainAuthCodeDto`
- **Schema:** `dna schema domain.update-auth-code` (MCP tool: `domain_update_auth_code`)

Every input can also be given as JSON with --body (inline, @file or - for stdin); flags override it.

| flag | type | description |
|---|---|---|
| `--domain-name` | string | Domain name (required; or argument 1 &lt;domain&gt;) |
| `-d`, `--body` | string | Full input as JSON: inline, @file, or - to read stdin |
